approachName: FADE-FIRST TDM SPINE: one shortcut → fight bots in Arena4v4 TDM on a real greybox map, alien-mesh player + bots, working pulse rifle, minimal canvas FADE HUD. Build the single missing piece (a runtime bot spawner/team-fill director driven by a real GameMode), reuse everything else.
firstRunnable: After Milestone M1 (one compile gate), the user double-clicks WANEFALL_BETA.bat and lands in Wanefall_Arena4v4_Prototype_01 in -game windowed PIE with the existing self-arming AWanefallArena4v4GameState placed and a SpawnerDirector that fills TeamB up to N bots at the map's PlayerStarts, then plays a real 3-2-1 countdown → RoundActive TDM round against autonomous bots that already chase/strafe/LOS-fire (AWanefallBotLiteEnemy), with the existing pulse rifle (PulseRifle->TryFire) killing them and the round scoring TeamA on each elimination. This is reachable in ~3 concrete steps: (1) add AWanefallBetaMatchGameMode (subclass of AWanefallPrototypeGameMode) that on BeginPlay finds-or-spawns the Arena4v4 GameState + a new bot director; (2) add AWanefallBotSpawnDirector that runs the fill loop World->SpawnActor<AWanefallBotLiteEnemy> at APlayerStart transforms, SetTeam(TeamB), then calls GameState->RefreshBotRoster(); (3) point DefaultEngine.ini GlobalDefaultGameMode at the new GameMode and ship WANEFALL_BETA.bat. Bots still render as cubes and HUD is still ASCII at M1 — those are intentionally deferred to M2/M3 so the FIRST runnable loop is one compile gate away. No nav is required because Arena4v4_Prototype_01 is the flat 62-SMA cube arena the bot-lite straight-line chase already handles.
botFillStrategy: NEW class AWanefallBotSpawnDirector (AActor) is the single missing piece. On BeginPlay (invoked by the new GameMode) it: (1) gathers spawn transforms via TActorIterator<APlayerStart> on the loaded map (Arena4v4_Prototype_01 has ~21 PlayerStart refs — plenty); (2) reserves the player's start, then runs a real fill loop `for (int i = AliveOnTeamB; i < DesiredBotsPerTeam; ++i) World->SpawnActor<AWanefallBotLiteEnemy>(class, StartXform, Params)`, calling Bot->SetTeam(EWanefallTeam::TeamB) on each (optionally a few EWanefallTeam::TeamA ally bots for true 4v4); (3) after spawning, calls the EXISTING AWanefallArena4v4GameState::RefreshBotRoster() so the already-working round/score/respawn loop (ApplyRoundStateToBots, TickBotRespawns) picks them up with zero changes. DesiredBotsPerTeam is a UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere) defaulting to 4, optionally read from FWanefallModeDefinition.TeamSize later. This reuses AWanefallPrototypeThreatSpawner::SpawnEnemyAt as the exact spawn pattern but for the bot-lite class. Respawn/elimination/scoring already exist in the GameState and need no new code — the director only handles INITIAL fill. No nav needed on the flat arena; the bot-lite 6s stuck-reset-to-home is the safety net.
assetWiringStrategy: The 71 assets are StaticMeshes (confirmed: each is <Name>/StaticMeshes/<Name>.uasset, no skeleton), so they wire in as STATIC meshes on static-mesh slots — never as skeletal ACharacter bodies. (A) BOTS: AWanefallBotLiteEnemy already roots on a UStaticMeshComponent and sets /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube in its ctor (line 26-30); add an EditAnywhere TSoftObjectPtr<UStaticMesh> BotBodyMesh and in BeginPlay/RefreshVisual call Body->SetStaticMesh(loaded SM_Char_0N) + clear the cube scale — so bots render as the 8 alien soldiers (round-robin by team/index). (B) GUN: AWanefallPrototypeCharacter::BuildVisibleWeapon already does WeaponBodyMesh->SetStaticMesh(SM_Rifle) (line 1915); swap that one path to /Game/Wanefall/Dimwit/Weapons/SM_Wpn_Gun_03_pulse_carbine/StaticMeshes/SM_Wpn_Gun_03_pulse_carbine — firing is unchanged (PulseRifle->TryFire→FireFromView). (C) PLAYER BODY: keep the rigged engine mannequin (SKM_Manny) because the Dimwit aliens have no skeleton and cannot locomote; player identity stays material/species-based (existing ApplySpeciesProfile) for the first loop. To guarantee the assets cook and aren't stripped as unreferenced, the soft refs live on the spawned bot + weapon (hard-touched at runtime) — no separate registry needed for M2. A proper id→mesh DataAsset registry (UWanefallAssetRegistry under the bible's UWaneSubsystem) is deferred to a later milestone; mech/vehicle/grenade meshes are out of scope for first-runnable.
packagingStrategy: PIE-launch, NOT a cooked build. The project carries heavy marketplace content (Paragon/Soul City/Cave) so a clean cook+pak is slow/fragile; the proven ShowMeAI HumanTestLaunch pattern is the fast path. Ship ONE file WANEFALL_BETA.bat that runs: "C:/UE_5.8/Engine/Binaries/Win64/UnrealEditor.exe" "C:/Users/developer/Documents/Unreal Projects/WanefallGreybox/WanefallGreybox.uproject" /Game/Wanefall/Maps/Wanefall_Arena4v4_Prototype_01 -game -windowed -ResX=1600 -ResY=900. Because DefaultEngine.ini GlobalDefaultGameMode will be repointed to AWanefallBetaMatchGameMode, opening that map boots straight into the filled TDM match — the user double-clicks once and is fighting bots. For the edit→play loop add a 2-line build+launch combo .bat (line1 = "C:/UE_5.8/Engine/Build/BatchFiles/Build.bat" WanefallGreyboxEditor Win64 Development -Project="...WanefallGreybox.uproject" -WaitMutex; line2 = the UnrealEditor.exe -game line). The existing 342MB Development Game WanefallGreybox.exe still reads loose Content and is not redistributable — do not rely on it for testers on other machines; a real cooked package is a separate late milestone if external distribution is ever needed.

NEW class AWanefallBotSpawnDirector : public AActor (new files Public/WanefallBotSpawnDirector.h + Private/WanefallBotSpawnDirector.cpp). approachName: Shared Wane Core spine + one MatchDirector that drives every mode, bot-filled — incremental mode lighting on a single compiling module
firstRunnable: After M1 (one compile gate): launch the existing one-click pattern UnrealEditor.exe <uproject> /Game/Wanefall/Maps/Wanefall_Arena4v4_Prototype_01 -game -windowed, and a new AWanefallMatchDirector (placed once, or auto-spawned by a new AWanefallMatchGameMode set via DefaultEngine.ini) reads the mode row, SPAWNS bots up to TeamSize via World->SpawnActor<AWanefallBotLiteEnemy> at PlayerStarts, and runs the existing TDM round loop end-to-end. User can shoot bots, see score climb to 25, watch bots respawn — a full TDM match with zero hand-placement. ~2 steps: double-click WANEFALL_BETA.bat, play.
botFillStrategy: New AWanefallMatchDirector::FillTeams() reads the active FWanefallModeDefinition (TeamCount, TeamSize, ScoreLimit, Objective) from UWanefallModeRegistry::BuildDefault and runs a fill loop: for each team, while alive-on-team < TeamSize, World->SpawnActor<AWanefallBotLiteEnemy> at a PlayerStart (gathered via TActorIterator<APlayerStart>), call Bot->SetTeam(EWanefallTeam) + Bot->Activate(), then register into the round shell. Model the spawn call on AWanefallPrototypeThreatSpawner::SpawnEnemyAt (the one existing SpawnActor-an-enemy pattern) but for the bot-lite class. The human local player counts as one slot on TeamA, so fill is (TeamSize - humansOnTeam). FFA/BR map all bots to distinct EWanefallTeam buckets (TeamA for the human, TeamB for everyone, scored as last-standing). BR fills to 24 combatants, Extraction to 8, Arcade to its racer/brawler count. Bots are pooled+reused on respawn via the existing AWanefallArena4v4GameState::TickBotRespawns / ResetBot path, generalized into the director so non-TDM modes get respawn too.
assetWiringStrategy: Two distinct seams because the Dimwit assets split by type. (1) WEAPONS are the low-effort win and become real: add a new UDataAsset UWanefallWeaponDef (UStaticMesh* Mesh + Damage + FireInterval + MagazineSize + ReserveAmmo + Spread + bAuto + EWanefallWeaponClass) and a UWanefallWeaponRegistry (UGameInstanceSubsystem) mapping ItemId->WeaponDef, populated with the 25 SM_Wpn_Gun_* + 11 SM_Wpn_Melee_* + 10 SM_Wpn_Gren_* by hard path /Game/Wanefall/Dimwit/Weapons/<Name>/StaticMeshes/<Name>. Generalize AWanefallPrototypeCharacter::BuildVisibleWeapon (currently hardcodes /Game/NiagaraExamples/.../SM_Rifle into WeaponBodyMesh->SetStaticMesh) to pull mesh+stats from the equipped WeaponDef and feed Damage/FireInterval/MagazineSize into the existing UWanefallWanePulseRifleComponent / UWanefallPrototypeWeaponComponent fields — firing code is untouched, only data+mesh swap. A weapon-cycle input proves the spread. (2) CHARACTERS: the 8 SM_Char_* soldiers + 8 SM_Char_Mech_* are STATIC meshes with no skeleton, so they CANNOT drive the locomoting ACharacter. They become (a) selectable IDENTITY (a UWanefallCharacterDef id->static-mesh + display name + the existing EWanefallSpecies material family) shown as rotating static-mesh props in the front-end character-select, and (b) the bot body: swap AWanefallBotLiteEnemy's placeholder /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube for the chosen SM_Char_* static mesh via its existing BodyDMI/RefreshVisual seam. The human pawn keeps the rigged engine mannequin + per-species material (ApplySpeciesProfile already does this) so it still animates; the chosen Dimwit identity drives material/armor + the select-screen portrait, NOT a new rig. This is honest: no rigging work is implied. Vehicles (9 SM_Veh_*) wire the same way into the existing AWanefallScoutSkimmerPawn/AWanefallPrototypeVehicle mesh slot in the arcade/extraction modes.
packagingStrategy: PIE-launch, NOT cooked. Project carries heavy marketplace content (Paragon/Soul City) so a cooked .pak is slow/fragile; the proven path is editor -game windowed PIE exactly like the existing HumanTestLaunch/*.bat. Deliverable: one WANEFALL_BETA.bat cloned from WANEFALL_OPEN_V5_COMBAT_SANDBOX.bat that (line 1) optionally runs C:/UE_5.8/Engine/Build/BatchFiles/Build.bat WanefallGreyboxEditor Win64 Development -Project=<uproject> -WaitMutex to compile-if-stale, then (line 2) launches C:/UE_5.8/Engine/Binaries/Win64/UnrealEditor.exe <uproject> /Game/Wanefall/Maps/<FrontEndMap> -game -windowed -ResX=1600 -ResY=900. The user double-clicks that one file; the front-end map (new THE HOLD select scene) is the boot map so they pick mode+map+character+loadout then deploy. Set GlobalDefaultGameMode/GameDefaultMap in DefaultEngine.ini to the new front-end map + AWanefallMatchGameMode so a bare launch also works. Both UBT targets already build clean (DLL+exe dated 2026-06-25), so first run needs no compile.

milestones.title: Match spine: one GameMode + MatchDirector that spawns and bot-fills TDM end-to-end
milestones.goal: Replace hand-placed bots with a runtime spawner+filler and give the project a real per-match GameMode, so TDM runs end-to-end in PIE with zero hand-placement. This is the shared core every later mode reuses.
concreteTasks: ADD AWanefallMatchGameMode (AGameModeBase subclass, new files WanefallMatchGameMode.h/.cpp) — keeps DefaultPawn/Controller/HUD from AWanefallPrototypeGameMode but in BeginPlay/InitGame spawns one AWanefallMatchDirector and passes it the active mode id (read from a GameInstance selection, default Arena4v4_TDM).

ADD AWanefallMatchDirector (AActor, new files WanefallMatchDirector.h/.cpp): holds a UWanefallModeRegistry (via BuildDefault), resolves the active FWanefallModeDefinition, owns/spawns one AWanefallArena4v4GameState for TDM, and implements FillTeams(): TActorIterator<APlayerStart> to gather spawns, World->SpawnActor<AWanefallBotLiteEnemy> per missing slot up to TeamSize, Bot->SetTeam + Activate, then arena->RefreshBotRoster()/AddBotForProof. Model SpawnActor on AWanefallPrototypeThreatSpawner::SpawnEnemyAt.

EXTEND AWanefallArena4v4GameState: add a public SpawnAndRegisterBots path or expose RefreshBotRoster to pick up runtime-spawned bots (it already iterates TActorIterator<AWanefallBotLiteEnemy>, so spawned bots are auto-found on RefreshBotRoster — verify and call it post-fill).
SET DefaultEngine.ini GlobalDefaultGameMode = AWanefallMatchGameMode; keep GameDefaultMap = Arena4v4_Prototype_01 for now.
ADD HumanTestLaunch/WANEFALL_BETA.bat cloned from WANEFALL_OPEN_V5_COMBAT_SANDBOX.bat targeting Arena4v4_Prototype_01.
milestones.userCanTest: Double-click WANEFALL_BETA.bat: boots straight into Arena4v4 TDM, bots spawn automatically to fill 4v4 (no hand-placement), countdown runs, you shoot bots with the existing pulse rifle, the OPPOSING team scores on kills, bots respawn after 3s, match ends at score 25 or 300s with a winner banner. approachName: WANE Spine First, Then FADE, Then HOLD, Then WANE LINE — One-Module Sequential Build on the Proven Prototype Pawn/HUD/Arena Seams
firstRunnable: After Milestone M1 (spine-only, ~one compile): launch the existing default boot (UnrealEditor.exe WanefallGreybox.uproject /Game/Wanefall/Maps/Wanefall_WaneTrialJailCell_01 -game -windowed) and confirm the new UWaneSubsystem initializes and logs all 8 FWaneSignature rows + the resolved MF_Wane material function path via a `Wane.Dump` console command — zero gameplay regressions, ~3 steps (Build.bat WanefallGreyboxEditor, double-click WANEFALL_BETA.bat, type Wane.Dump). botFillStrategy: The recon proves the gap precisely: RefreshBotRoster() (WanefallArena4v4GameState.cpp:177-184) only TActorIterators ALREADY-PLACED AWanefallBotLiteEnemy actors — nothing spawns to a count, and TeamCount/TeamSize in FWanefallModeDefinition are inert data. Kharvex default, EditAnywhere serialized Species, ApplySpeciesProfile, SetSpecies).
